operations.setup: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm exec rer install
operations.verify: pnpm check:deployment-spec && pnpm exec rer check --profile first-party && pnpm run verify
operations.recovery: Follow OPERATIONS.md and RUN-LOCALLY.md: stop writes and scheduled work, retain private settings and a native export, restore into fresh empty resources, compare a re-export and verify native owner access before routing traffic. Preserve every applied migration name and byte.
